title: Nice colors, not very rugged
text:
Nice colors, not very rugged. I bought this disappointing item to cover a daybed. Its not likely to stand up to to use.The fabric is thin to flimsy and the cover is too small to fit the twin mattress its intended to cover., so yjhe corners don't hang properly. the pillow covers are also small/short. the bedskitrt is very short. I had to add an extension to that. I wish I had understood what the fabric would be like. I was expecting something more like a couch cover than chintz. I gave it ***** for light weight, thoug , in terms of overall quality, that is not a compliment. Also of note is t the fact that tere is a lot of machine stitching with too few stitches per inch. I.E.: if you sit on it, (as intended), the thread snags and pulls. Its pretty from a distance, but it won't last long.
As such, I don't recommend this for a daybed in regular use, but if you need something cheap and cheerful for a guest room, this might suit your need.
